result.keyword: What's the best e-signature software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For most small businesses, **Dropbox Sign, DocuSign and Adobe Acrobat Sign** are the three strongest options. However, the best choice depends on how many documents you send, whether you need legally binding signatures, and how much automation you want.

My recommendation would be to prioritise **ease of use, predictable pricing, legally recognised signatures and no unnecessary enterprise features**\.

## Best e-signature software compared

| Software | Best for | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Dropbox Sign | Simple contracts and agreements | Best overall for simplicity |
| DocuSign | Professional business signing | Best all-round reputation |
| Signable | UK small businesses | Best UK-focused option |
| Adobe Acrobat Sign | PDF-heavy businesses | Best for Adobe users |
| PandaDoc | Quotes, proposals and contracts | Best sales functionality |
| Zoho Sign | Businesses using Zoho | Best integrated value |


### My top three

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Dropbox Sign**

(Best for most small businesses)

- Very easy to use.
- Reusable document templates.
- Signing reminders and audit trails.
- Good integrations with cloud storage.

Website: [Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. DocuSign**

(Best established platform)

- Widely recognised by customers.
- Strong document tracking.
- Advanced signing workflows.
- Extensive integrations.

Website: [DocuSign UK](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Signable**

(Best UK small-business option)

- UK-based provider.
- Pricing by account rather than per user.
- Pay-as-you-go options.
- Useful for smaller teams sending contracts regularly.

Website: [Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

These are my recommendations based on usability, features and pricing models rather than a claim that one platform wins every category. ## What should you budget?

Indicative UK pricing\:

- **£10–£20/month\:** Basic signing for an individual.
- **£20–£40/month\:** More functionality for a small team.
- **£40+/month\:** Advanced workflows, automation and sales features.

Check annual billing, VAT, user limits and document-sending allowances before committing. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-esignature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[serpastra.com](https://serpastra.com/blog/best-e-signature-software-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[99datarooms.com](https://99datarooms.com/blog/how-much-does-e-signature-software-cost-in-the-uk-2026/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## One important UK legal consideration

Choose a provider that gives you\:

- A timestamped audit trail.
- Evidence of who signed and when.
- A tamper-evident completed document.
- Secure document storage and appropriate UK GDPR protections.

Electronic signatures are legally valid for most purposes in England and Wales, although certain documents have additional execution or witnessing requirements. search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
